selection.method: Lowest current-model probability of being correct among eligible unreviewed actual-act detections, with diversity and context exclusions. One focused reading per non-overlapping passage window; multiple readings may concern a long scene. This targeted batch cannot estimate overall accuracy or recall.
selection.model: Committed main-branch confidence model; per-reading probability, not aggregate scene/verdict confidence
selection.reviewMethod: Each selected passage read with surrounding context; proposed readings paraphrased. Reviewer confidence is subjective and uncalibrated. No proposals are accepted labels.
selection.confidenceMeaning: engineConfidence = model probability its individual reading is correct; proposal.confidence = reviewer confidence in the proposed assessment
selection.paragraphLayout: Original extracted story paragraphs; equal paragraph count and identical text in every reviewed evidence window verified against engine audit paragraphs.
